title: Dressed: A Century of Hollywood Costume Design
author: Deborah Nadoolman Landis

translation.context: A richly illustrated nonfiction history and reference book about twentieth-century Hollywood costume design. The text discusses cinema history, costume designers, actors, film productions, studios, garments, fashion, textiles, historical dress, visual culture and the creative process of designing costumes for film.

terminology.costume design: costumistica cinematografica / design del costume, secondo il contesto
terminology.wardrobe department: reparto costumi / guardaroba, secondo il contesto
terminology.fitting: prova costume / prova dell'abito, secondo il contesto

translation.instructions: Treat names of people, studios and film productions with particular care. Do not translate established film titles unless the source itself provides or clearly implies an Italian title. Preserve historical garment names when an established Italian equivalent is not appropriate. Distinguish carefully between fashion design and costume design for cinema.
